text:
leo: heads-up: deploy-bot blocked the postgres-subchart promotion during the marketing rollout. It detected a subchart version skew and a PVC size change in the overlay.

sara: ugh. what's the exact diff?

leo: deploy-bot pasted the diff: 

```
Chart: payments 2.3.0 -> 2.4.0
  +charts/postgres: 10.1.0 -> 11.0.0
~ charts/postgres.values.persistence.size: 5Gi -> 10Gi
~ charts/postgres.templates.persistentvolumeclaim.storageClassName: gp2 -> gp3
~ charts/postgres.crdVersion: v1beta1 -> v1
```

matt: that CRD bump (v1beta1 -> v1) is breaking for our on-prem clusters that still run older k8s. Blocking promotion is expected. Any reason it wasn't flagged earlier?

leo: the chart was in the dependency lock but the overlay values changed in the release branch. CI didn't run the cluster-compatibility preflight because the release was tagged as "non-breaking" by the author.

deploy-bot: Promotion halted: subchart version skew detected. Canary pool unchanged. Recommendation: do not promote until subchart compatibility validated.

olivia: conservative approach: revert the subchart bump in the release branch and open a follow-up to upgrade postgres in a staged maintenance window. We should avoid live PVC resizing during a non-maintenance release.

matt: Agreed. Two options: 1) pin subchart to 10.1.0 (no values change) and continue with the higher-level app bump; or 2) proceed with canary-only hotpatch that keeps legacy storage values and postpones PVC resize. I prefer option 1 (pin) for speed.

leo: pin sounds good. Could we also add an explicit "skip-pvc-resize: true" flag in the values to be extra-safe? Some clusters ignore resize in-place and require manual migration.

olivia: yes, let's add `postgres.persistence.skipResize: true` and pin charts/postgres=10.1.0 in the helm.lock. Also include a release-note entry: "Deferred postgres subchart upgrade (PVC resize & CRD bump) to scheduled maintenance. App image still promoted."

sara: can someone push the revert & pin? I'll verify cluster compatibility matrix afterwards.

matt: pushing fix now. PR https://git.internal/r/infra/payments-release/pull/242 - changes: 
```yaml
# values.yaml (release branch)
charts:
  postgres:
    version: "10.1.0" # pin to avoid CRD/storage changes
postgres:
  persistence:
    skipResize: true
    size: 5Gi
    storageClassName: gp2
```

matt: deploy-bot will trigger a redeploy after merge. Leaving a note in the PR for release manager @olivia.

deploy-bot: Redeploy triggered for payments-service canary (eu-west-1). Post-deploy checks: pods ready 3/3, no PVC events, canary metrics stable.

leo: thanks. olivia, can you add the release-notes blurb and mention the maintenance ticket ID for the full db upgrade?

olivia: will do. I'll create MAINT-1034 and link it in release-notes.md with: "Postgres subchart upgrade deferred - PVC size & CRD changes require maintenance window (MAINT-1034)."

sara: action item for infra: ensure preflight flags CRD/apiVersion changes and PVC size deltas >2x; if detected, require explicit maintenance flag on release. Adding INFRA-517.

leo: filing INFRA-517 now. Also adding a short rollback snippet to the runbook in case the pin fails:

```sh
# rollback to previous promoted chart
helm rollback payments-release --namespace prod <REVISION>
kubectl annotate deployment payments --namespace prod rirm/release-note="rollback due to subchart-pvc" 
```

matt: leaving a manual comment on the PR saying: "Pinned postgres subchart; postponed storage/CRD upgrade to MAINT-1034. Will coordinate with infra for upgrades."

olivia: cool. once release-notes updated I'll mark the release candidate as cleared for promo. :white_check_mark:

leo: nice coordination — closing this thread after PR merges.

matt: merged and release-bot scheduled promotion. :ship:
